{{Disambig|Sentry}}

==Towers==
'''Sentry''' may refer to these removed towers:
*[[Sentry]], a [[tower]] with a unique spool-up mechanic that allowed it to fire up to half its base firerate
**[[Sentry/Gallery]]
**[[Sentry/History]]

==Enemies==
'''Sentry''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Null Sentry]], an immobile enemy spawned by the [[Null Engineer]]

==Units==
'''Sentry''' may refer to these units:
*[[Minigun Sentry]], the third sentry the Level 5 [[Engineer]] spawns, costing 120 Scrap to build
**[[Minigun Sentry/Gallery]]
*[[Rifle Sentry]], the more advanced, second sentry the Level 3-4 [[Engineer]] spawns, costing 36 Scrap to build
**[[Rifle Sentry/Gallery]]
*[[Sentry (Unit)]], the first and most basic sentry the Level 0-2 [[Engineer]] spawns, costing 16 Scrap to build
**[[Sentry (Unit)/Gallery]]
*[[War Machine Sentry]], the final and most advanced sentry the Level 6 [[Engineer]] spawns, costing 250 Scrap to build, and being able to shoot rockets
**[[War Machine Sentry/Gallery]]

==Interactables==
'''Sentry''' may refer to these [[interactables]]:
*[[Bunny Sentry]], an offensive map item in [[Bathroom Approach]]
